classes.name: Age-related Macular Degeneration
classes.description: Dry/atrophic or non-neovascular AMD features (drusenoid RPE changes, GA) without active CNV.

classes.name: Choroidal Neovascularization
classes.description: Neovascular membrane with subretinal/intraretinal fluid or pigment epithelial detachment; wet AMD spectrum.

classes.name: Central Serous Retinopathy
classes.description: Serous neurosensory retinal detachment, often with RPE bump; central serous chorioretinopathy.

classes.name: Diabetic Macular Edema
classes.description: Retinal thickening with intraretinal cystoid spaces and/or hard exudates in a diabetic context.

classes.name: Diabetic Retinopathy
classes.description: OCT features of diabetic retinopathy without frank center-involving edema (microaneurysms, mild disorganization).

classes.name: Drusen
classes.description: Discrete sub-RPE deposits; early/intermediate AMD risk marker without CNV or GA.

classes.name: Macular Hole
classes.description: Full- or partial-thickness foveal defect, often with cuff of subretinal fluid or vitreomacular traction.

classes.name: Normal
classes.description: No pathological OCT findings; preserved foveal contour and retinal layer architecture.

notes: `group` is consumed by the CDS rule layer (configs/cds/rules_v1.yaml) for urgency mapping, not by the classifier.
`oct_c8_dir` / `dir_aliases` map on-disk folder names to canonical keys for both OCT-C8 and the OPTOPOL external set.
Class ids are frozen. If classes change, bump the label_map `dataset` tag and retrain — do not silently reorder.
